name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: I'm applying for the Account Manager role because it's the exact job I've built my career around: owning a portfolio, keeping retention high, and finding the next growth lever for each client rather than waiting for them to ask.

At Birdeye, I managed 15 to 20 reseller partners across health, home services, and retail, retaining all but one (about 94%) by staying proactive on health metrics and risk signals before they became churn. That same instinct runs through my time at Wix, where I managed a high-value account portfolio to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates, and at Accelo, where escalating risk early and advising clients through CRM adoption was part of the daily job. On the analytics side, I run GA4, Semrush, and technical SEO audits hands on for my own clients now, which lines up directly with the tools this role calls out.

I haven't worked in tourism specifically, but the pattern (a portfolio of businesses relying on one platform to run their operations and drive revenue) is one I know well from SaaS. I'd welcome the chance to bring that same retention and growth discipline to FareHarbor's client base.
